## 简体中文

- Redis 命令台支持选择逻辑库，普通新建使用连接默认库。
- 改善 Redis 键浏览、命令历史和连接设置。
- 优化对象树键盘操作、窄窗口布局与多标签切换。
- 改善结果表格的只读值查看、筛选行号与分页操作。

提供 macOS Apple Silicon DMG，Apple 公证待完成。

## English

- Added Redis console database selection and configurable default database.
- Improved Redis key browsing, command history, and connection settings.
- Improved keyboard navigation, narrow layouts, and workspace tab switching.
- Improved read-only cell inspection, filtered row numbers, and pagination.

The macOS Apple Silicon DMG is not notarized.
